parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language in which you want the results to be displayed. Valid values: zh-CN (default value): Chinese. en-US: English

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The microservice namespace to which the application belongs.

parameters.name: PageIndex
parameters.description: The first page number. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 6.

parameters.name: Resource
parameters.description: The interface for which the protection rule is configured.

parameters.name: ResourceSearchKey
parameters.description: The interface keyword in the protection rule.
